name: Good Things About The Dark
source:
Help this nyctophobic person find their way back to their camp, and maybe help them work with their fear of darkness. Or make them be even more scared of the darkness, your choice!

[From [url=https://radiokiro.itch.io/good-things-about-the-dark]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
帮助一位恐暗症患者找到回营地的路，也许还能帮TA克服对黑暗的恐惧。或者让TA变得更加害怕黑暗，由你决定！

[来源：[url=https://radiokiro.itch.io/good-things-about-the-dark]Itch.io[/url]]
